newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 4.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - April 4.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Westpac Banking Corp on Thursday unveiled an audacious A$1.435 billion bid for the much-smaller Bank of Melbourne Ltd, confident it would win the support of regulators and the national government. The friendly bid had been mooted by market speculators the previous day when shares in Bank of Melbourne, a regional bank with a strong mortgage loan book, jumped sharply. The Australian Stock Exchange is reportedly investigating irregular share trading on Wednesday. Moody's and S&P have affirmed Westpac's ratings.
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$16.94 (+0.25)
Newspapers report speculation that a sale of BHP's 37 percent stake in Foster's stake is imminent, with Foster's buying back 10 percent and Merrill Lynch taking the rest to place at a later date.

Coca-Cola Amatil transformed itself on Thursday into the largest Coca-Cola bottler outside the United States by unveiling an A$3.4 billion (US$2.6 billion) deal with San Miguel Corp of the Philippines.

Sydney Harbour Casino Holdings Ltd said late on Thursday the High Court of Australia had dismissed the action by Kerry Packer to challenge the 1994 decision to award the Sydney casino licence to Sydney Harbour Casino (SHC).
